+---
+## What
+SK-7, D128 (e): no Seatbelt. `docs/security.md:5-12` ("No OS sandbox in v1") names `sandbox-exec`, the Seatbelt tool, and says to examine an OS sandbox again later. The word "Seatbelt" is not in the file; the Seatbelt text is this `sandbox-exec` paragraph.
+- Remove the `sandbox-exec` sentences and the "Examine this again" sentence.
+- Replace the paragraph with the two modes of SK-7a: in `open` mode, `` !`shell` `` injection and `run script` run as child processes with the rights of the user; in `sandboxed` mode, the App Sandbox is the sandbox, `run script` is not available, and the body keeps the injection text. Keep the "Every child process has a group, a timeout and an output limit" text for `open` mode.
+- Make the text agree with what SK-7a built (the `RenderPolicy` switches stay or go).
+- Write in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `docs/security.md` has no `sandbox-exec`, no "Seatbelt" and no "OS sandbox in v1".
+- [ ] `docs/security.md` names `ToolMode` and tells what each mode does to `run script` and the shell injection.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/DocumentationTests.swift`: add a test that `docs/security.md` has no `sandbox-exec` and no `Seatbelt` (case-insensitive), and that it names `sandboxed`.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #step1
\ No newline at end of file
